subject: Your therapist is waiting at 3AM
preview_text: Right now, while you're awake, your AI therapist is ready. One tap changes the spiral.
body_paragraphs: It's 3AM. You're staring at the ceiling, your phone glowing in the dark. The thoughts are looping—her laugh, his text, that last fight. You know you shouldn't check their profile, but your thumb is already moving. I've been there. The 3AM spiral is a beast that feeds on silence and shadows.

But here's the thing: right now, at this exact hour, there's a way to break the cycle. Fresh Start's emergency mode is built for moments like this. It's not a generic breathing exercise; it's a guided intervention that rewires your brain in 60 seconds. Users who tap it during a 3AM spiral report a 40% faster recovery from intrusive thoughts. You don't have to fight alone in the dark.

Open the app. Hit the red button that says 'I'm spiraling.' Let the AI therapist talk you down like a friend who's been through it. It'll ask you one question, then lead you through a custom coping strategy based on your breakup type. No judgment, no 'just move on'—just a path back to solid ground.
Do it now. One tap, and the spiral loses its grip. P.S. The no-contact streak tracker will show you how many days you've saved yourself from a midnight text. That number matters more than you think.
